name: hyp_EI_276
claim: 276-vertex graph in the hyperbolic plane H^2, every edge joins two points at hyperbolic distance exactly d (Exoo-Ismailescu distance d_EI), no 4-coloring (certificate: cert2_hyp_276.cnf and cert2_hyp_276.drat in this folder).
model: hyperboloid model: <X,Y> = -t t' + x x' + y y'; points X = (t, x, y) with <X,X> = -1, t > 0; hyperbolic distance d(X,Y) = arccosh(-<X,Y>); edge iff -<X,Y> = cosh d exactly

field.description: K = Q(c), [K:Q] = 4. Coordinates: t, xh, yh in K; real point (t, R*xh, R*s*yh) with R = sqrt(2c-1), s = sqrt(1-c^2).

exact_coordinate_format: each of t, xh, yh is [q0,q1,q2,q3] (strings, rationals) meaning q0 + q1 c + q2 c^2 + q3 c^3
real_point_from_exact: X = (t, R*xh, R*s*yh), R = sqrt(2c-1), s = sqrt(1-c^2); <X,Y> = -t t' + (2c-1) xh xh' + (2c-1)(1-c^2) yh yh'
decimal_note: 30 digits after the decimal point, rounded; hyperboloid (t, x, y); Poincare disk (x/(1+t), y/(1+t))
